one_liner.zh: 本周加密独自加速：BTC 窗口 +23.6%、ETH 更猛，标签「强趋势上涨」叠加「清算驱动上涨段挤压」，与美股 ES/NQ 走弱形成「股弱币强」脱钩；高实现波动下 IV 相对 RV 仍折价，现货 ETF 通道呈强流入。
one_liner.en: Crypto accelerated alone this week: BTC window +23.6%, ETH stronger, labeled strong uptrend plus liquidation-driven upside squeeze, decoupling as equities ES/NQ weakened; high realized vol with IV still cheap vs RV, spot ETF channel in strong inflow.

zh: BTC ETF 周净流 +19.18 亿美金

risk.zh: 永续/现货放热、OI 周降约 5%，挤压后若 funding 维持高位或再出现 08-19/08-21 量级清算峰（未必与 OI 同日顶），波动可能从「实现高」转向更尖锐回撤；与「双高次日退烧」周不同，本周更是多日强出清。
risk.en: Hot perp/spot with OI ~−5% week: after the squeeze, if funding stays high or 08-19/08-21-scale liq peaks return (not necessarily same-day OI top), vol may shift from high realized toward sharper drawdowns; unlike a dual-high-then-fade week, this was multi-day strong flush.

watch.zh: 盯脱钩与 ETF 强流入是否续写；杠杆侧：清算驱动是否再现（笔数/qty 峰量级），以及在无强清算峰时 OI+funding 是否再堆；IV 折价在高 RV 下会否收窄。
watch.en: Watch decouple and strong ETF inflow; on leverage: whether liq-driven peaks (count/qty scale) return, and whether OI+funding rebuild without strong liq peaks; whether IV discount narrows under high RV.

leverage.zh: 清算驱动（上涨段挤压迹象）

vol_premium.zh: 期权偏便宜（IV 相对 RV 折价）

compare.zh: BTC +23.6% 对 ES -1.5%、NQ -2.5%，黄金 +5.6% 同向偏强而美元指数小跌，传统风险资产偏弱、加密与部分避险资产更热闹，脱钩标签「股弱币强」本周写得很清楚。
compare.en: BTC +23.6% versus ES -1.5% and NQ -2.5%, gold +5.6% firmer while DXY slipped slightly—traditional risk assets soft, crypto and some haven-like assets busier, making the decoupled crypto-up equity-down label plain.

path.zh: 窗口从 baseline 收盘起强趋势上涨；中段 08-19 qty 清算峰与 08-21 笔数峰+大涨日并置，OI 周高错开在 08-20，全周 OI 深降——上涨段带有多日挤压/出清痕迹，而非单日双高模板；ETH 窗口收益更高，节奏更陡。
path.en: Strong uptrend from baseline close; mid-window pairs 08-19 qty liq peak with 08-21 count peak + big up day, OI week high staggered on 08-20 and OI down hard on the week — multi-day squeeze/flush traces, not a single dual-high template; ETH steeper.

leverage.zh:
标签：清算驱动（上涨段挤压迹象）。
① 拥挤线：funding 约 +4.2%/yr → +11.0%/yr 走高（租金变贵）；OI 周变约 −4.9%（110963 → 105550）——拥挤价格↑、库存↓，与「只加杠杆堆仓」不同。
② 出清线：清算很强——峰值约 4.2× 周内中位；qty 峰在 08-19（约 862），笔数峰在 08-21（n≈3379），两日都要点名。OI 周高在 08-20（约 107639），与笔数峰 08-21、qty 峰 08-19 均不同日——本周不是 09-03 那类「清算∥OI 同日双高」。08-21 大涨日（约 +7.3%）OI 收在约 106118，低于 08-20 周高；全周 OI 深降更支持出清/回吐库存，而非单日 OI 还冲顶。side 未定，只并陈。
③ 量旁证：永续约 1124 亿美金，WoW 约 +175%，活跃度偏热——热换手与强清算并陈。
收句：强清算 + OI 周降 + 费率走高 + 热量，支撑「清算驱动/上涨段挤压」标签；结构上与 08-31 周（同标签、09-03 双高后次日退烧）不同，勿套同一事件日范文。不归因涨跌。
leverage.en:
Label: liquidation-driven (upside squeeze traces).
① Crowding: funding ~+4.2%/yr → ~+11.0%/yr (rent richer); OI week ~−4.9% (110963 → 105550) — dearer funding with falling inventory, not “only add leverage.”
② Flush: very strong liq — peak vs median ~4.2×; qty peak 08-19 (~862), count peak 08-21 (n≈3379) — name both days. OI week high 08-20 (~107639), not same day as either liq peak — not a 09-03-style same-day liq∥OI dual-high. On the +7.3% 08-21 day OI settled ~106118, below the 08-20 high; deep week OI drop supports flush/inventory giveback more than a single-day OI spike top. Side unset; structure only.
③ Volume: perp ~112.4B USD, WoW ~+175%, activity hot — hot turnover beside strong liq.
Close: strong liq + week OI down + funding up + hot activity support the squeeze label; structure differs from the 08-31 week (same label, 09-03 dual-high then next-day fade) — do not copy one event template. No price causation.

etf.zh: 美现货 BTC ETF 合计净申赎约 +19.18 亿美金（强流入，5 入 0 出，单日高点约 8/20），ETH ETF 约 +6.97 亿美金；并陈 Binance 侧 BTC 现货成交额周合计约 122.04 亿美金、环比约 +161%（热），只并列通道与热闹程度，不把净流写成涨跌原因。
etf.en: US spot BTC ETF aggregate net about +1.92B USD (strong inflow, 5 in / 0 out, peak day ~Aug 20), ETH ETF ~+697M USD; alongside Binance-side BTC spot turnover week sum ~12.20B USD, WoW ~+161% (hot)—channel and activity in parallel only, not as the cause of the print.

spot_volume.zh: Binance 现货成交额（turnover 美金，程序周合计）：本周 122.04 亿美金，相对上完整周 +161.0%（活跃度「偏热」；上周约 46.76 亿美金）。峰值日 2026-08-21（34.02 亿美金）。这是交易所现货「换手热闹程度」，与 ETF 净申赎同属现货世界、只并陈；对照永续周成交额 1123.63 亿美金——两者量级不同，**禁止相加**，也**不能**拆多空。
spot_volume.en: Binance spot turnover (USD, program week sum): this week 12.20B, vs prior full week +161.0% (activity “hot”; prior ~4.68B). Peak day 2026-08-21 (3.40B). Spot tape busyness beside ETF net flow — same spot world, no sum with perp (112.36B); not a long/short split.

vol_teach.zh: 实现波动量的是已经走完的路径长度，IV 是期权定价的前瞻拥挤度；本周路径很陡（高 RV）而 IV 仍折价，意味着保险相对已发生波动并不贵，但并不保证折价持续。
vol_teach.en: Realized vol measures path length already walked; IV is the forward crowding priced in options. A steep path (high RV) with IV still at a discount means insurance is not rich versus what already printed—without promising the discount lasts.

vol_week.zh: BTC 实现波动年化约 65%，期末 IV 约 43%，IV−RV 约 -22 个百分点，标签高实现波动 + 期权偏便宜；ETH RV 更高、IV 亦高于 BTC，波动层级整体抬升。
vol_week.en: BTC realized vol ~65% ann., end IV ~43%, IV−RV ~-22 pp—high realized with options cheap vs RV; ETH RV higher still and IV above BTC, vol regime elevated across the board.

vol_combo.zh: 高 RV + IV 折价 + 强趋势上涨同时出现：趋势跟随着享受方向，波动收割类策略则面临「已波动够大、权利金却不厚」的错配。
vol_combo.en: High RV + IV discount + strong uptrend together: trend-followers ride direction, while vol-harvest styles face a mismatch of large already-realized moves against still-thin premium.

vol_price_iv.zh: 价格大涨段与 IV 期末水平并未同步飙到「贵」，折价标签仍在；若后续 RV 回落而 IV 横着，折价可能收窄，反之若再出急杀，IV 才有机会快速补定价。
vol_price_iv.en: The sharp price leg did not drag end IV into rich territory—the cheap label held. If RV later cools while IV holds, the discount may tighten; another air-pocket could let IV re-price faster.

vol_vix.zh: VIX 括号内约 +6.2%，美股偏弱时传统波动计略抬，与加密高 RV 同向偏闹，但资产价格上仍是股弱币强，波动共鸣并未强制价格联动。
vol_vix.en: VIX ~+6.2% in its bracket—traditional vol gauge ticked up as equities softened, rhyming with crypto’s high RV in ‘busyness’ without forcing price linkage (still equity down, crypto up).

vs_crypto.en: This week “Decoupled: Crypto Up / Equities Down”—don’t explain crypto with equities alone.

what.zh: 美股隐含波动指数 VIX

vs_crypto.zh: VIX 中低位小动通常解释不了币的大涨跌；与上一节加密 IV 只做角色对照。
vs_crypto.en: Small VIX moves rarely explain big crypto moves; role-parallel to crypto IV only.

vs_crypto.zh: 美元略弱可作弱背景，不是主引擎。
vs_crypto.en: Mild USD softness is backdrop, not the main engine.

vs_crypto.zh: 利率与币涨跌若相反，则不是单纯降息交易。
vs_crypto.en: If yields move opposite crypto, this is not a pure cut-trade story.

vs_crypto.zh: 与 BTC 同向可兼容，但是不同资产逻辑。
vs_crypto.en: Same direction as BTC is compatible; drivers still differ.

tradfi_summary.zh: 美股括号 ES -1.5%、NQ -2.5%，VIX 抬升，DXY 小跌，美债 10Y 约 +4.2 bp，黄金 +5.6%；传统风险偏防守、美元稍松，与加密强趋势脱钩并立。
tradfi_summary.en: US bracket: ES -1.5%, NQ -2.5%, VIX up, DXY slightly down, US10Y ~+4.2 bp, gold +5.6%—TradFi risk on the back foot, dollar a touch softer, standing beside crypto’s strong trend as a decouple.

three_conclusions.zh: 价格与标签：强趋势上涨 + 清算挤压（08-19 qty 峰 / 08-21 笔数峰，OI 周降约 5%，非必须同日双高），BTC +23.6%、ETH +31.3%，与 ES/NQ 下跌并立，脱钩是本周主叙事。
three_conclusions.en: Price/labels: strong uptrend + liq squeeze (08-19 qty peak / 08-21 count peak, OI ~−5% week, not requiring same-day dual-high); BTC +23.6%, ETH +31.3% vs ES/NQ down — decouple is the main story.

three_conclusions.zh: 波动结构：高 RV（BTC ~65%）而 IV 仍折价（~43%，IV−RV ~-22pp），期权不便宜在「已发生」之外再加一层拥挤税。
three_conclusions.en: Vol structure: high RV (BTC ~65%) with IV still cheap (~43%, IV−RV ~-22pp)—options did not add a crowding tax on top of what already printed.

three_conclusions.zh: 现货通道：BTC ETF 强流入约 +19.18 亿美金，现货成交额周合计约 122 亿美金且环比大增，与永续热度并陈，资金与换手都在场。
three_conclusions.en: Spot channel: BTC ETF strong inflow ~+1.92B USD beside spot turnover week sum ~12.2B USD and a large WoW jump, parallel to hot perp activity—both flow and turnover present.

text.zh: 「股弱币强」脱钩是否在下一窗口仍成立（加密继续显著强于 ES/NQ）。
text.en: Whether crypto-up equity-down decouple still holds next window (crypto still clearly stronger than ES/NQ).

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周脱钩是主矛盾，若下周股指反弹而币回吐，叙事会立刻改写。

text.zh: BTC 现货 ETF 净流是否维持强流入姿态（或转为连续流出）。
text.en: Whether BTC spot ETF net stays in strong-inflow stance (or flips to consecutive outflows).

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周从净流出翻到 +19.18 亿强流入，是通道侧最大变量，适合做下期核对哨。

text.zh: IV 相对 RV 的折价是否仍在（IV−RV 大幅为负），或高 RV 后 IV 快速补涨变贵。
text.en: Whether IV remains cheap vs RV (large negative IV−RV) or IV catches up and turns rich after high RV.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 高实现波动与期权折价同时出现是本周特色，折价收窄与否直接影响波动类策略体感。

matched.zh: trend_following 与「强趋势上涨」及窗口大额正收益同向：路径连续、清算日更像挤压加速而非反转信号，故趋势类逻辑与本周标签匹配。
matched.en: trend_following aligns with the strong-uptrend label and large positive window return: continuous path, liquidation day reading more like squeeze acceleration than reversal—hence trend logic matched the week’s tags.

mismatched.zh: mean_reversion 与强趋势、挤压上涨相逆；vol_harvest 在高 RV 且 IV 相对折价时，权利金厚度不足、已实现波动已先消耗路径，故二者与本周结构错配。
mismatched.en: mean_reversion fights strong trend and upside squeeze; vol_harvest faces high RV with IV still cheap—premium not thick while path length was already spent—so both mismatched this week’s structure.
